title: Apple's 'resilient and recurring' cash flow generation means investors can stop worrying about the iPhone (AAPL)
text: Apple's 'resilient and recurring' cash flow generation means investors can stop worrying about the iPhone (AAPL) By Kimberly Chin Mar 9, 2018, 11:08 am 13 pts Apple investors should shift their focus from iPhone X sales to its outsized free cash flow generation, an RBC Capital Markets analyst says. The company's free cash flow generation is "resilient and recurring," which could make investors very happy. With an estimated free cash flow generation of…
